title: 아내가 매일 두 사람의 밥을 차리는 이유

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 어느 날부터 남편은 매일 함께 밥을 먹던 아내를 알아보지 못했습니다.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 평생 무뚝뚝했던 남편은 밥 한 끼에도 고맙다는 말을 하지 않았죠.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 그러던 어느 날, 남편은 치매 진단을 받았습니다.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 시간이 흐르자 아내의 이름도, 얼굴도 기억하지 못했습니다.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 그래도 아내는 매일 두 사람의 밥을 차렸습니다.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: male
scenes.text: 아주머니는 누구신데 매일 저랑 밥을 드세요?
scenes.style: An elderly Korean man in his seventies. Low, softly raspy, warm and slightly hesitant conversational voice. Natural restrained emotion. No theatrical acting.

scenes.speaker: female
scenes.style: A Korean grandmother in her seventies. Warm, aged, gently trembling and tender voice; held-back tears without exaggerated sobbing. Natural conversation.

scenes.speaker: male
scenes.text: 그럼 내가 아주머니를 많이 좋아했나 보네요.
scenes.style: An elderly Korean man in his seventies. Low, softly raspy, warm and slightly hesitant conversational voice. Natural restrained emotion. No theatrical acting.

scenes.speaker: female
scenes.text: 많이 좋아하셨죠. 표현을 안 하셨을 뿐이지.
scenes.style: A Korean grandmother in her seventies. Warm, aged, gently trembling and tender voice; held-back tears without exaggerated sobbing. Natural conversation.

scenes.speaker: male
scenes.text: 그런데 이상하네요. 기억은 안 나는데, 아주머니랑 밥을 먹으면 마음이 참 편해요.
scenes.style: An elderly Korean man in his seventies. Low, softly raspy, warm and slightly hesitant conversational voice. Natural restrained emotion. No theatrical acting.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 아내는 울면서 웃었습니다. 기억을 잃어가는 남편 곁에서, 두 사람의 식탁은 오늘도 이어졌습니다.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: 당연하게 생각했던 오늘의 한 끼가, 누군가에게는 가장 소중한 시간일지도 모릅니다.
scenes.style: A mature Korean female narrator, warm, intimate and restrained, with gentle emotional weight; clear pronunciation and no theatrical pauses.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.style: Low and warm, steady Korean female narrator. Quiet downward falling intonation, no dramatic pause.
